prompt: Read paper_pipeline/data/tool_data.csv and paper_pipeline/data/secondary_data.csv. Find every item that appears in BOTH files. For each common item return its name followed by a colon and the SUM of its quantity values from both files. Return one item per line, sorted alphabetically by item name. Return ONLY these lines, nothing else.
_note: tool_data.csv has apple:3 and coffee:2; secondary_data.csv has apple:7 and coffee:3. Common items: apple (3+7=10), coffee (2+3=5). mango and banana appear in only one file each.
_reviewer_link: R2.1 — multi-source reasoning task expands benchmark scope beyond trivially narrow single-file queries.
